title: Harden validation agent timeouts/retries + failure log bundling
author: Gabe Wilson
description:
Context: During the staged rollout (us-east / A100), we saw a meaningful number of nodes stuck in Validating due to the validation agent hanging on long-running checks (notably NCCL smoke and occasional disk/network probes) and retry behavior that was either too aggressive (hammering transient failures) or too timid (never recovering from short blips). Operators also lacked actionable artifacts when a node failed a gate, which increased time-to-triage and led to more “blind reimage” remediation.

This PR hardens the validation agent execution model by introducing: (1) per-step timeouts with a total budget, (2) structured retries with exponential backoff + jitter scoped to known-transient failures, and (3) log bundling on failure with basic redaction and stable artifact pointers for Fleet Readiness.

What changed (high level): Add a cancellation-aware runner with per-step timeouts and a global validation deadline; Introduce retry policy config (max attempts, base delay, max delay, jitter) and classify retryable errors (timeouts, temporary network errors, transient NCCL init errors) vs non-retryable (driver parity mismatch, GPU health/Xid, ECC threshold, image channel mismatch); Bundle a “failure capsule” (agent log, step stdout/stderr tail, nvidia-smi -q, dmesg tail, kubelet/containerd status, relevant sysfs hints) and upload to our internal artifact store; Emit a single stable artifact_url plus artifact_sha256 into the validation result record so the control plane/UI can link without embedding per-node high-cardinality metadata in metrics.

Motivation / incident notes: This is directly informed by flake reports from the first rollout week (nodes oscillating between retries and eventual quarantine, with little detail) and by SUP-28433/SUP-28457 where support needed concrete failure reason + logs pointer to avoid repeated reimages.

Configuration / rollout: The agent remains backwards compatible; new behavior is gated by config defaults and can be tuned via the existing agent config map. Default per-step timeouts are intentionally conservative for us-east/A100 and can be widened for slower regions/GPU types.

Key defaults: step_timeout_default=8m, step_timeout_overrides={"nccl_smoke": "12m", "perf_canary": "10m"}; global_validation_deadline=25m; retry_max_attempts=3; retry_backoff_base=15s; retry_backoff_max=2m; retry_jitter=0.2; log_bundle_on_failure=true; log_bundle_max_bytes=25MB.

Notes on security: Log bundles redact obvious secrets (env vars matching *_TOKEN/*_KEY/*_SECRET, kubelet client cert paths) and avoid capturing full journal output (tail only). Artifact upload uses the agent’s existing workload identity and stores in the same bucket/prefix as other node validation artifacts.

Testing: Unit tests for timeout cancellation, retry classification, and bundle assembly; integration test updated to assert artifact_url is present on failure and that retries stop after max attempts; manual validation on a canary pool (1 node) by forcing NCCL timeout and confirming the bundle links in readiness service.

Release notes: Improves robustness of provision-to-ready validation (fewer stuck Validating nodes; better artifacts for triage).
commits: validation-agent: add context-aware step runner + total deadline enforcement
validation-agent: implement retry policy w/ exponential backoff + jitter
validation-agent: classify retryable vs non-retryable failures (nccl/network/timeouts)
validation-agent: add failure log bundle generation + artifact upload
readiness client: record artifact_url + sha256 and normalize error codes
tests: add timeout/retry/bundle coverage; update integration fixtures
docs: update internal agent config reference + troubleshooting notes

final_notes: Merged ahead of the next us-east/A100 expansion window. Rollout plan: enable log_bundle_on_failure + new timeouts in canary pool first, monitor Validating duration distribution and quarantine rate for 24h, then roll to all staged pools. If validation wall time increases >15% or artifact upload error rate >2%, disable log bundling via config and revert to previous step timeouts while keeping retry classification (safe).
